_note: Prompt-optimization eval set. `expect` drives scoring: grounded_numeric (answer must cite figures present in retrieved passages), comparison (should compare/likely chart), thematic (qualitative, graph/global ok), clarify (should ask a clarifying question, not loop), refuse (must emit the scope-refusal), find_or_admit (figure may be absent -> must answer OR admit-not-found in <=2 tries, never loop), meta (capability/greeting -> answer directly, no tool). `must_contain_any` = normalized substrings, at least one acceptable for a pass. `hard_number` = a ground-truth figure the answer should contain when correct.
